name: migration-without-rollback
repoContext:
## CONTRIBUTING.md

# Contributing to ledgerd

## Database changes

Every migration in `migrations/` must ship with a matching `.down.sql` file that reverses it. Deploys roll back by running the down files in reverse order.

## Handlers

Prefer `errors.Is` over comparing errors with `==`. Longer handlers are usually easier to read once the parsing moves to a helper.

findings.title: The migration has no `.down.sql` file
findings.description: The PR adds `migrations/0042_invoice_due_date.up.sql` and no file that reverses it. `CONTRIBUTING.md` requires a matching `.down.sql` file for every migration, and a deploy that rolls back past this migration has nothing to run for it. Add `migrations/0042_invoice_due_date.down.sql` that drops the `due_date` column.
